questions.stem: What is the term used to describe the events that occur after fertilisation, including the development of the endosperm and embryo, maturation of the ovule into a seed, and the ovary into a fruit?
questions.solution: Post-fertilisation events refer to the series of biological processes that occur after fertilisation, including the development of the endosperm and embryo, the maturation of the ovule into a seed, and the ovary into a fruit. Double fertilisation is a process that occurs prior to these events and involves the fusion of sperm cells with the egg and central cell. Embryogeny specifically refers to the development of the embryo, while endosperm development is a component of the overall process but not the complete term.

questions.stem: What is the term used for fruits that develop without fertilisation?
questions.solution: Parthenocarpic fruits are the term used for fruits that develop without fertilisation, as they result from the development of the ovary without the need for fertilization. False fruits refer to those that develop from parts other than the ovary, apomictic fruits involve reproduction without fertilization but not necessarily fruit development, and seedless fruits describe the absence of seeds, not the process of development.

questions.stem: What is the term for the process of formation of megaspores from the megaspore mother cell?
questions.solution: Megasporogenesis is the correct term for the process of forming megaspores from the megaspore mother cell. Ovulogenesis refers to the development of ovules, embryogenesis involves the formation of an embryo, and gametogenesis is the production of gametes. Each of these terms describes different biological processes and does not specifically refer to the formation of megaspores.

questions.stem: What is the process of transferring pollen grains from the anther to the stigma called?
questions.solution: The process of transferring pollen grains from the anther to the stigma is known as pollination. Fertilisation involves the fusion of male and female gametes, germination refers to the growth of a pollen tube, and embryogenesis is the development of an embryo. Therefore, the correct answer is pollination.

questions.stem: A plant has flowers that are not colorful and do not produce nectar. What is the most likely method of pollination for this plant?
questions.solution: Wind-pollinated flowers are typically not colorful and do not produce nectar because they rely on the wind, not animals, to transfer pollen. In contrast, insect and bird pollinated flowers are usually colorful and produce nectar to attract pollinators. Water pollination is rare and also does not involve nectar or bright colors. Therefore, wind pollination is the most likely method for this plant.

hi.solution: हवा परागित पुष्प आमतौर पर रंगीन नहीं होते और न ही गुलाबी रस उत्पन्न करते हैं क्योंकि वे जानवरों के बजाय हवा पर निर्भर रहते हैं। इसके विपरीत, कीट और पक्षी परागित पुष्प आमतौर पर रंगीन होते हैं और परागण के लिए आकर्षक बनाने के लिए गुलाबी रस उत्पन्न करते हैं। जल परागण अत्यंत दुर्लभ होता है और गुलाबी रस या चमकदार रंग के साथ भी नहीं होता। इसलिए, इस पौधे के लिए हवा परागण सबसे संभावित विधि है।

questions.stem: If a plant has a pistil that matures before the stamens, what is the most likely outcome?
questions.solution: If a plant's pistil matures before its stamens, it is more likely to receive pollen from other flowers because the female part is ready to accept pollen before the male part produces it. This timing increases the chance of cross-pollination, where pollen from a different plant fertilizes the ovule. Self-pollination is less likely because the stamens have not yet produced pollen, and no pollination is unlikely because the pistil is functional. Double fertilization is a process that occurs after pollination and is not directly related to the timing of maturation.

hi.stem: यदि एक पौधे में एक वर्तिकाग्र जो बीजाणुधानी से पहले पकता है, तो सबसे संभावित परिणाम क्या होगा?
hi.solution: यदि एक पौधे का वर्तिकाग्र बीजाणुधानी से पहले पकता है, तो यह अधिक संभावना है कि यह अन्य फूलों से पराग को ग्रहण करे क्योंकि मादा भाग पराग को स्वीकार करने के लिए तैयार हो जाता है जबकि नर भाग पराग उत्पन्न करता है। यह समयावधि अंतः परागण की संभावना बढ़ाती है, जहां एक अलग पौधे के पराग अंडाणु के निषेचन में सहायता करता है। स्व-परागण कम संभावित है क्योंकि बीजाणुधानी अभी तक पराग उत्पन्न नहीं करती है और कोई परागण असंभावित है क्योंकि वर्तिकाग्र कार्य करता है। द्विगुणित निषेचन परागण के बाद एक प्रक्रिया है और परिपक्वता के समय से सीधे संबंधित नहीं है।

questions.stem: What is the main reason for cleistogamous flowers to always undergo autogamy?
choices: The anthers and stigma are closely positioned
The pollen grains are not viable
The flowers do not open at all
questions.solution: Cleistogamous flowers do not open at all, which ensures that pollination occurs within the same flower. questions.stem: A researcher observes that a flower has a pistil that matures days before the stamens. What is the most likely evolutionary advantage of this?
questions.solution: When the pistil matures before the stamens, it increases the chance of receiving pollen from other flowers, which promotes genetic diversity through cross-pollination. This is an evolutionary advantage because it enhances the genetic variability of the species. Self-pollination would occur if the pollen from the same flower fertilizes the pistil, which is not the case here. Preventing fertilisation and causing apomixis are not related to the timing of maturation and do not provide an evolutionary benefit.

questions.stem: A researcher observes that in a particular flowering plant, the pistil matures several days before the stamens in all flowers of the plant. What is the most significant consequence of this timing difference?
questions.solution: If the pistil matures before the stamens, the stigma is ready to receive pollen from other flowers, which increases the chances of cross-pollination. Self-pollination and autogamy require pollen from the same flower, which is not ensured by this timing. Geitonogamy involves pollination between flowers on the same plant, but the timing difference promotes interaction with external pollen sources.

questions.stem: In some seeds, the endosperm persists in the mature seed and is used up during germination. Which of the following seeds is an example of this?
questions.solution: Coconut is an example of a seed where the endosperm persists in the mature seed and is used up during germination. In peas, groundnuts, and beans, the endosperm is completely consumed by the developing embryo before seed maturation. This is why these seeds are considered non-albuminous.

hi.stem: कुछ बीजों में परिपक्व बीज में भोजन ऊतक बना रहता है और अंकुरण के दौरान इसका उपयोग किया जाता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा बीज इसका एक उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: नारियल एक ऐसा बीज है जिसमें परिपक्व बीज में भोजन ऊतक बना रहता है और अंकुरण के दौरान इसका उपयोग किया जाता है। मटर, मूंगफली और मूंग में भोजन ऊतक बीज के परिपक्व होने से पहले विकसित भ्रूण द्वारा पूरी तरह से उपभोग कर लिया जाता है। इसी कारण इन बीजों को अन-एल्ब्यूमिनस माना जाता है।

questions.stem: Why does the zygote remain dormant after fertilisation in the ovule?
choices: To allow the endosperm to develop first
questions.solution: The zygote remains dormant to allow the endosperm to develop first because the endosperm provides essential nutrients for the developing embryo. Without this nutrient supply, the embryo would not have the resources needed for growth. The other options, while plausible, do not align with the biological necessity of nutrient provision before embryo development.

hi.solution: जाइगोट अस्थायी रूप से बर्बर रहता है क्योंकि एंडोस्पर्म के विकास के लिए आवश्यक होता है क्योंकि एंडोस्पर्म विकासशील भ्रूण के लिए महत्वपूर्ण पोषक तत्व प्रदान करता है। बिना इस पोषक तत्व के आपूर्ति के, भ्रूण के विकास के लिए संसाधन नहीं होंगे। अन्य विकल्प, यथासंभव, जैविक आवश्यकता के साथ मेल नहीं खाते हैं क्योंकि भ्रूण विकास से पहले पोषण प्रदान करना आवश्यक होता है।
